decision: The TCS load limiter uses the IEC curve: 36.5 barg 100 %, 35.0 barg 92 %, 34.0 barg 85 %, 31.5 barg 65 %, 29.0 barg 45 % GT load; the EPC gas station is designed for <= 4.7 bar pressure loss from TP-G1 to IF-01 at base-load flow.
rationale: TQ-IEC-014; ER-03.03 / TQ-017 load limitation between 40 and 45 barg.
title: GT load limiter versus fuel gas pressure at IF-01
